== DESTRUCTIVE  (no undo — dry-run + confirm required) ==
  ban_member           Ban a user from a server.
                       required: guild_id, user_id
  cancel_event         Close a server's scheduled event: one that hasn't started is CANCELLED, one that is running now is ENDED (completed). Discord never reopens either. Its details and cover picture are saved first, so it can be made again with create_event.
                       required: guild_id, event_id
  delete_automod_rule  Delete one of a server's AutoMod rules. Its full settings are saved first, so it can be made again with create_automod_rule (with a new id).
                       required: guild_id, rule_id
  delete_channel       Delete a channel and every message in it.
                       required: channel_id
  delete_emoji         Delete a custom emoji.
                       required: guild_id, emoji_id
  delete_message       Delete a single message.
                       required: channel_id, message_id
  delete_role          Delete a role, stripping it from everyone who has it.
                       required: guild_id, role_id
  delete_sound         Delete one of a server's soundboard sounds. A copy of the sound file is saved first.
                       required: guild_id, sound_id
  delete_sticker       Delete one of a server's stickers. A copy of its picture is saved first (except a Lottie animation, which Discord won't hand out).
                       required: guild_id, sticker_id
  kick_member          Kick a member (they can rejoin with an invite).
                       required: guild_id, user_id
  prune_members        Prune a server (Server Settings > Members > Prune): kick every member who has no roles and hasn't been seen for `days` days (1-30, default 7). Members whose only roles are in include_role_ids are counted too. The dry-run asks Discord how many would go - Discord never says WHO. They can rejoin with an invite, but the prune itself can't be undone.
                       required: guild_id
  purge_guild          Bulk-delete messages across EVERY text channel in a server.
                       required: guild_id
  purge_messages       Bulk-delete messages in a channel, optionally filtered by age or author.
                       required: channel_id
